## Implementation Complete

All three requirements are working and tested:

**1. Pagination on `/products` endpoint:**
- Default limit: 20 items
- Maximum limit: 100 items (clamped server-side)
- Supports offset-based pagination via `?offset=N&limit=M`
- Supports cursor-based pagination (default, stable under data changes)
- Returns pagination metadata: `total`, `limit`, `offset`, `hasMore`, `nextOffset`/`nextCursor`
- Supports sorting: `?sort=field` or `?sort=-field` (ascending/descending)
- Sortable fields: `id`, `name`, `price`, `category`, `createdAt`
- Supports filtering: `?category=ELECTRONICS`, `?active=true`
- Filterable fields: `category`, `active`

**2. Rate Limiting per IP:**
- Token-bucket algorithm with 60-request burst capacity
- 1 request/second sustained rate (configurable via env: `RATE_LIMIT_PER_SEC`)
- Returns `429 Too Many Requests` when exceeded
- Includes `Retry-After` header (in seconds) on rate-limit responses
- Includes `ratelimit-remaining` header on all responses
- Keyed by client IP via `req.ip` (respects `trust proxy` setting)

**3. Request Logging with Trace IDs:**
- Every request gets a unique UUID `x-request-id` header
- Honors inbound `x-request-id` header if valid (safe characters only, max 128 chars)
- Logs structured JSON with fields: `requestId`, `method`, `url`, `statusCode`, `durationMs`
- Separates "request received" and "request completed" log entries
- Includes correlation ID on all error responses
- Logs are escaped/redacted: hides `Authorization`, `Cookie`, passwords, tokens
- Four-level logging: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`
